title: Calendar feed
body: Subscribe in Google Calendar, Apple Calendar or Outlook to see your open tasks with a due date. Each feed has its own secret link; calendar apps check it for changes on their own schedule, often only a few times a day.
offline: You’re offline. Calendar feeds can be changed once you’re back online.
limit: You have {max, number} feeds, the most you can have. Revoke one to create another.
regenerateConfirm: Get a new link for {name}? The current link stops working at once, so calendars that subscribe to it need the new one.
revokeConfirm: Revoke the feed for {name}? Calendars that subscribe to it stop getting updates.

reveal.title: Your feed for {name}
reveal.secret: Keep this link secret: anyone who has it can see your task titles and due dates. It is shown only now. If it gets out, get a new link.
reveal.label: Feed link
